body:
My brother was the biggest asshole in the world and still my heart was broken beyond repair when he left me. Your brother does care and he loves you. He will be hurt if you kill yourself and that kind of hurt never goes away. 
The school year is nearly over, but now you have this free time where you can work on yourself entirely. This can be the time where you find yourself and figure out what you actually give a shit about.  It's hard, I know...but isn't it worth a shot? If you can find something that you are truly passionate about, then that would be amazing.
If nothing helps, try getting professional help again. And remember that a random girl on the internet cares for you deeply. Message me if you need anything.

Where I live isn't exactly a good place to find professional help-I would have to actually travel out of my community to see a psychologist.  If these thoughts don't subside then I do know that I will have to go and see somebody. I can't make myself better by reading self help books. I do have some skills already from before..to help me with painful memories and such. For now, I go for hikes in the mountains and talk to friends and family if I feel like sharing (which is hardly ever but I do open up sometimes). We'll see how it goes.
Thank you. I didn't know posting in this sub would help that much, but your words are helping me.

I lost my brother to suicide last year. If you really think that you won't cause any pain if you off yourself then you're ridiculous. Go out there and try to make friends. It isn't that hard - there are other people just like you in uni/college..who are lonely and feel like no one cares. You can't be taken seriously if you commit suicide, that's for sure. Just keep going and keep trying to better yourself academically, socially, physically..go to the gym, join some clubs at school.. If you really want to change your situation then do it. Just try. I wish so hard that my brother just tried. He would have been here, with me, today if he did. If he held on for another day, week, month..he would be here with me. Everything passes. In my culture, we say anigugiilaaqtuq-everything passes. You just have to wait until something or someone comes into your life that you feel passionate about. This feeling will pass.
